upg2:2.2: evaṁ tuyhaṁ jayo hotu, jayassu jayamaṅgalaṁ!
upg2:6.1: Yaṁ kiñci ratanaṁ loke vijjati vividhā puthū
upg2:6.2: ratanaṁ Buddhasamaṁ natthi: tasmā sotthī bhavantu te!
upg2:7.1: Yaṁ kiñci ratanaṁ loke vijjati vividhā puthū
upg2:7.2: ratanaṁ Dhammasamaṁ natthi: tasmā sotthī bhavantu te!
upg2:8.1: Yaṁ kiñci ratanaṁ loke vijjati vividhā puthū
upg2:8.2: ratanaṁ Saṅghasamaṁ natthi: tasmā sotthī bhavantu te!
upg2:9.1: Natthi me saraṇaṁ aññaṁ, Buddho me saraṇaṁ varaṁ!
upg2:10.1: Natthi me saraṇaṁ aññaṁ, Dhammo me saraṇaṁ varaṁ!
upg2:11.1: Natthi me saraṇaṁ aññaṁ, Saṅgho me saraṇaṁ varaṁ!
upg2:12.2: mā te bhavatvantarāyo, sukhī dīghāyuko bhava!
